scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync --all-groups && cd ../web && pnpm install
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check src tests spike
scripts.format: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix --select I src tests spike && uv run ruff format src tests spike && cd ../web && pnpm format
scripts.format:check: cd backend && uv run ruff format --check src tests spike && cd ../web && pnpm format:check
scripts.check: yarn format:check && yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn build
